prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Regional Dispatch Center (Juniper) provides continuous protocol-governed intake, triage, dispatch/coordination; creates incident records, compares conditions/zone coverage, escalates unresolved readiness gaps. Ambulance Coordination Platform shares incidents, assignments, availability, coverage/access constraints. Computer Aided Dispatch Console supports intake/dispatch, checks locations against address/maps; staff verify currency.
Call Taker Mara (Larkspur) establishes location before medical details: address, municipality, building/floor/entrance; repeats address/checks landmarks; requests callback number; collects age, consciousness, breathing, chief concern, reliable symptom-onset time; distinguishes observed/secondhand symptoms; records barriers. Produces Caller Location Correction Slip for documented address clarification; unresolved locations require follow-up/incident updates; stays engaged when information could change priority/access.
Triage Supervisor reviews/sets priority, coordinates clinical prioritization with dispatch as demand/access changes. Regional Medical Director sets triage policy/delegation; staff follow protocols/escalate beyond authority. Shift Commander (Sundial) manages continuity/conflicts/surges, reviews readiness/repositioning/coverage adjustments, escalates beyond authority to jurisdictional leadership; cannot supersede clinical authority. Paramedic Crew owns scene assessment/care within scope/protocols; reports barriers/readiness via established communications. Ambulance Unit 417 joins response pool when assigned.
Hospital Liaison Desk (Kestrel) coordinates capacity/destination constraints; Emergency Department communicates receiving considerations; Riverside Trauma Center destination requires suitability/availability.
Jurisdictions retain ownership/local policy. Zones reflect distance/access/capacity; jointly maintained boundaries reviewed after road/population/agreement changes. Primary/alternate routes to both destinations follow clinical/access constraints; dispatch considers travel/weather/restrictions/closures; crews verify constrained routes.
North Gate Status Board displays northern access/queues, produces North Approach Queue Snapshot; South Gate Status Board displays southern access/entry restrictions; check both at shift start/relevant changes.
Radio Coordinator (Mistral) monitors Regional Radio Network; confirms channels/backup procedures each shift; checks weak-area coverage.
Fleet Maintenance Cell (Bluejay) tracks serviceability/maintenance/defects, produces Battery Swap Voucher authorizing replacement. Readiness checks staffing/communications/supplies/fuel/vehicle/restrictions; reassess after significant incidents/interruptions/route-access changes.
Data Quality Officer checks record completeness/consistency/information-handling compliance.

New part:
S066: The Hospital Liaison Desk supports intake coordination by confirming facility capabilities and clarifying hospital contact pathways.
S067: The Hospital Liaison Desk checks whether a reported destination preference is compatible with current facility capabilities.
S068: When a facility constraint affects coordination, the Hospital Liaison Desk records the constraint in the incident notes.
S069: The Hospital Liaison Desk produces the Bedside Arrival Receipt when an ambulance arrival has been confirmed.
S070: The Hospital Liaison Desk provides current facility information through established coordination channels without delaying emergency call intake.
S071: The Triage Supervisor reviews incidents when the reported symptoms or uncertainty warrant clinical escalation.
S072: The Data Quality Officer monitors intake records for recurring gaps in location or medical detail.
S073: Call Taker Mara updates the incident record when a caller provides new information before dispatch decisions are finalized.
S074: The Regional Dispatch Center preserves the original caller report alongside subsequent clarifications so responders can distinguish confirmed details from estimates.
S075: Clinical triage begins after Call Taker Mara has captured the caller's reported symptoms, location, and immediate hazards.
S076: The recorded information provides an initial basis for assigning urgency and does not replace clinical reassessment as new information arrives.
S077: Triage Supervisor reviews incidents with uncertain severity, conflicting reports, or signs of rapid deterioration.
S078: Priority is based on the immediacy of threat to life, the likely time sensitivity of care, and the risk of deterioration while awaiting response.
S079: Incidents indicating an immediate threat receive the highest available response priority and prompt dispatch action.
S080: Incidents without an immediate threat are prioritized according to the expected harm from delay and the patient's reported condition.
S081: When essential information is missing, Triage Supervisor directs focused clarification while ensuring that information gathering does not delay an urgent response.
S082: Triage Supervisor escalates clinically ambiguous or unusually severe cases to Regional Medical Director for guidance when time permits.
S083: Regional Medical Director provides clinical policy guidance and does not replace the operational authority responsible for dispatch decisions.
S084: Triage Supervisor sends the Pediatric Acuity Note.
S085: Triage Supervisor is known operationally as Copperfield.
S086: Data Quality Officer is known operationally as Pebble.
S087: Data Quality Officer monitors incident records for missing, inconsistent, or duplicated information that could impair triage or dispatch.
S088: Data Quality Officer sends the Duplicate Incident Audit Memo.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
